title: Replacement at end of design life under intolerable risk
text: Mains whose service age exceeds the material-specific design life and whose overall risk is classified intolerable shall be programmed for replacement; renewal by rehabilitation is not appropriate once the structural design life is exhausted.

title: Likelihood-consequence risk matrix
text: Asset intervention priority is set by combining the likelihood of failure with the consequence of failure in a four-band risk matrix: negligible, tolerable, significant and intolerable. Intolerable risks require action in the current planning period.

title: Rehabilitation of deteriorated mains
text: Where condition assessment grades a main as poor or very poor (grade 4 or 5) and the overall risk is significant or intolerable, structural or semi-structural rehabilitation such as relining should be considered before replacement.

title: Risk-based inspection intervals
text: Each main shall be inspected at an interval set by its overall risk category: 4 years for intolerable, 8 years for significant, 15 years for tolerable and 20 years for negligible risk. An exceeded interval triggers a scheduled inspection.

title: Condition assessment before committing to renewal
text: Mains with intolerable risk that remain within design life and are not yet graded poor shall receive an urgent condition assessment to confirm the renewal option.

title: Critical customers and supply continuity
text: Mains supplying hospitals, schools and care homes carry elevated consequence of failure; interventions on these mains require supply continuity planning and customer notification.

title: Continued monitoring of low-risk mains
text: Mains with negligible or tolerable risk and no exceeded inspection interval remain in routine monitoring through burst records and network telemetry.

title: Valve exercising programme
text: Isolation valves shall be exercised on a regular cycle so that sections of main can be isolated quickly during bursts and planned works.

title: Pump efficiency review
text: Pumps whose wire-to-water efficiency falls well below the manufacturer curve shall be reviewed for refurbishment or replacement of the impeller.

title: Pressure management
text: Pressure management zones should reduce excess night pressure to lower leakage and burst frequency while maintaining the minimum service pressure.

title: Service reservoir cleaning
text: Service reservoirs and tanks shall be drained, inspected and cleaned on a fixed cycle to protect water quality.
